en.title: H.A.P
en.decryption: Remember Harsha's religious tilt: He was initially a devotee of Shiva/Sun, then shifted to Buddhism under Hiuen-Tsang (Xuanzang).

hi.title: H.A.P
hi.decryption: Remember Harsha's religious tilt: He was initially a devotee of Shiva/Sun, then shifted to Buddhism under Hiuen-Tsang (Xuanzang).

fact.en: Mistaking Harsha as a 'Buddhist from birth'. He transitioned late in his reign.
fact.hi: Mistaking Harsha as a 'Buddhist from birth'. He transitioned late in his reign.

fact.en: Confusing the Prayag Assembly (charity) with the Kannauj Assembly (theological debate).
fact.hi: Confusing the Prayag Assembly (charity) with the Kannauj Assembly (theological debate).

fact.en: Assuming Harsha enforced Buddhism as a state religion; he remained religiously tolerant.
